description: This PHP source file implements the ANTLRStringStream class, which provides a character stream interface for tokenizing input strings in a parser or lexer. It supports operations like consume, lookahead, marking positions, seeking, and extracting substrings.

classes.name: ANTLRStringStream
classes.description: A class implementing CharStream for reading characters from a string input, with support for lookahead, marking, seeking, and line/column tracking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the stream with input data, converting the string into an integer array and setting initial parsing state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the stream to its initial state without changing the data.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Advances the stream position by one character, updating line and column counters.

methods.name: LA
methods.description: Lookahead character at a specified offset relative to current position.

methods.name: LT
methods.description: Alias for LA function, for backward compatibility.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Returns the current position/index in the stream.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the input data.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current stream state for backtracking.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Restores the stream to a previously marked position.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the current position to a specified index, consuming characters if necessary.

methods.name: substring
methods.description: Extracts a substring from the input data between two indices.

methods.name: getCharPositionInLine
methods.description: Retrieves the current character position within the line.

methods.name: setCharPositionInLine
methods.description: Sets the character position within the current line.

methods.name: getSourceName
methods.description: Returns the source name associated with the stream.
